description: PIT, 2005 June regular phase: 50 of 50 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 50 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 50 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240809084926: 50 listed, 50 matched to MLB's picks by name (2 by surname in the same round: #331 MLB "Christopher Jones" / "Chris Jones"; #961 MLB "Matthew Acors" / "Matt Acors")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
